Each entry was reviewed against its handler (TabHandlers, TabHandlers+More, TabLifecycle, NewTabSlot, NewTabSubmit, PaneTabBarHandlers, TabGroupHandlers, TabGroupHandlers+Moves, GroupIconHandlers, TabIconHandlers, PaneBackgroundHandlers, StashHandlers, BrowserTabAudio, PictureInPictureHandlers, ResourceHandlers, TabSearchHandlers, AppActions+Workspaces, WorkspaceHandlers, WorkspaceGroupHandlers, WindowManager+Creation, ColumnHandlers, PaneHandlers, DaemonClosedHistory, PreviousLaunchRestorer). Legacy bind and run handlers report action.done, as closeWindow's bindEffect does; a socket refusal is control.unavailable. A socket run has no focus: it selects nothing, so setups that need another selected tab run Next Tab, a focus action. I3 on every create (the task's rule): each action step records before, turn and settled, and each create states what its turn must already show. Creates whose handler waits for the daemon before anything shows file a `divergence` note and the follow-up that makes them optimistic (p15-oracle-321 the slot of a positioned new tab, 312 tab group writes, 313 windows, workspaces, reopens and typed new tabs, 314 tab and group moves into new containers); 310 makes invariants.py pair an optimistic create's stand-in (pending_tab_ id, surface, title, size) with the daemon's object, without which I3 reports every stand-in. invariants.py runs on a trace and is not yet part of a run (p15-oracle-110's follow-up of 017, 023, 047), so these cases are green on their outcome and waitFor checks now and turn I3's verdicts into Failures with it. 315 adds the tab and tab-group icon, the tab tint and the saved tab groups to the facets, 316 a tab-group target and the tab groups and saved groups a run made in action.run's `created` (tabGroup.addTab and tabGroup.reopenSaved stay blocked live-value until it lands). Blocked by the sweep's flags: tabGroup.close (destructive). Excluded by every-action-gaps.json: newCloudMachine, newCloudWorkspace, tab.restart, tab.screenshot, tabGroup.deleteSaved.
